{
  "name": "Hearty Chinese Egg Drop Soup",
  "category": "dinner",
  "description": "Egg drop soup is a super-common dish in many Asian households. Each region (and even household) has a slightly different take on the traditional soup. Some like to use chicken broth, while others use vegetable broth. I decided to make a heartier soup by adding ground chicken so that if you're hungry after work, the soup is very quick to put together and will fill you up in a hurry.",
  "servingSize": "2",
  "prepTime": "5 minutes",
  "cookTime": "15 minutes",
  "totalTime": "20 minutes",
  "ingredients": [
    {
      "name": "Clarified Butter (page 283) or ghee",
      "amount": "2",
      "unit": "teaspoons",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "2"
    },
    {
      "name": "green onions",
      "amount": "2",
      "unit": "",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": "chopped, white and green parts separated",
      "printedAmount": "2"
    },
    {
      "name": "fresh ginger",
      "amount": "2",
      "unit": "teaspoons",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": "minced",
      "printedAmount": "2"
    },
    {
      "name": "ground chicken or turkey",
      "amount": "1/2",
      "unit": "pound",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1/2"
    },
    {
      "name": "fresh shiitake mushrooms",
      "amount": "1",
      "unit": "cup",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": "sliced, stemmed",
      "printedAmount": "1"
    },
    {
      "name": "salt",
      "amount": "1/2",
      "unit": "teaspoon",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1/2"
    },
    {
      "name": "Whole30-compliant chicken broth or Chicken Bone Broth (page 280)",
      "amount": "3",
      "unit": "cups",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "3"
    },
    {
      "name": "coconut aminos",
      "amount": "2",
      "unit": "tablespoons",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "2"
    },
    {
      "name": "ground cumin",
      "amount": "1/2",
      "unit": "teaspoon",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1/2"
    },
    {
      "name": "eggs",
      "amount": "3",
      "unit": "large",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "3"
    },
    {
      "name": "Toasted sesame oil",
      "amount": null,
      "unit": null,
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": null
    }
  ],
  "instructions": [
    "HEAT the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the white parts of the green onions and the ginger and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add the ground chicken, mushrooms, and salt and cook until the chicken is no longer pink and the mushrooms are tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Add the broth, coconut aminos, and cumin, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer.",
    "IN a small bowl, whisk the eggs for 30 seconds. Holding a fork over the saucepan, slowly pour the eggs through the tines of the fork and whisk the broth gently as you pour. Let the soup stand for a few seconds to finish cooking the eggs.",
    "TOP with the green parts of the green onions, drizzle with sesame oil, and serve."
  ],
  "notes": null,
  "tags": ["Soups, Stews, and Noodle Bowls", "Chinese", "Whole30"],
  "source": "I Heart Umami"
}
